affected_system: municipal buildings, distributed energy, electrification, and emissions management
alternatives: verify the highest-consequence signals before acting on municipal building energy, comfort, and emissions anomalies
combine targeted inspection, monitoring, and data-quality repair for municipal building energy, comfort, and emissions anomalies
pair meter, weather, occupancy, equipment, and work-order reconciliation with an explicit stop, review, and escalation rule
assumptions: Meters, fuels, tariffs, weather, occupancy, equipment, projects, and emissions factors are versioned.
Modeled energy and carbon savings remain distinct from measured post-project performance.
All alternatives, capacities, costs, effects, thresholds, and failure scenarios are proposed until bound to evidence.
baseline: continue current inspection and reporting practice for municipal building energy, comfort, and emissions anomalies.

constraints.description: The municipal energy and building decarbonization diagnose must respect declared measurement resolution and classification uncertainty.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
decision_owner: municipal energy director and public-building portfolio manager
decision_question: Which buildings show weather- and occupancy-adjusted energy, comfort, equipment, or emissions anomalies?

independence_key.binding_constraint: The municipal energy and building decarbonization diagnose must respect declared measurement resolution and classification uncertainty.
independence_key.decision_object: municipal building energy, comfort, and emissions anomalies
independence_key.evidence_gate: Evidence for municipal building energy, comfort, and emissions anomalies passes documented checks for coverage, semantics, geography, timestamps, and uncertainty.
independence_key.intervention_mechanism: meter, weather, occupancy, equipment, and work-order reconciliation
independence_key.primary_outcome: verified excess energy and emissions above building baselines

intended_claim: A versioned diagnose design for comparing declared alternatives affecting municipal building energy, comfort, and emissions anomalies, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: verified excess energy and emissions above building baselines
distributional gap in verified excess energy and emissions above building baselines
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not label benchmark deviation waste, malfunction, discomfort, or avoidable emissions without verification.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Evidence for municipal building energy, comfort, and emissions anomalies passes documented checks for coverage, semantics, geography, timestamps, and uncertainty.

title: Diagnose municipal building energy and emissions performance
transportability_risks: Climate, grids, tariffs, fuels, building codes, stock, occupancy, and finance differ.
Operational changes can confound retrofit performance comparisons.
